description: 保留直接综合毁伤主头，同时用破片和冲击波序数概率作为训练期辅助监督；联合 terminal_geometry_v2 与硬等级目标，避免固定 OR 融合累积两个机制头的估计误差。

ablation.note: The deployed forward path remains a direct combined-damage predictor. Mechanism heads are training-only auxiliary tasks and never consume realized hits, penetration outcomes, component damage, target aim points or sampling provenance.
